title: Install the exact-origin Local Network Access policy

verify.summary: Two fresh reviewers passed source exact-origin shape and static gates but found the validator accepted non-exact URL-pattern forms and treated a synthetic source file as effective; the host has no real managed Chrome policy export or chrome://policy LNA entry.

The corrected source validator and all negative probes pass, but both fresh reviewers confirmed that the development host has no real managed Chrome policy or chrome://policy LNA entry. Synthetic source-as-effective input is not accepted as browser evidence; this is an upstream managed-kiosk environment blocker.

TASK-063 is blocked after two bounded verification attempts because effective managed Chromium policy and restart/listed-unlisted browser evidence require the real kiosk host. Resume on that host with a redacted chrome://policy export, then rerun fresh verification and T3 red-verification.

Two fresh reviewers independently confirmed the real host-managed Chrome policy, exact origin, Machine/Mandatory/OK chrome://policy rendering, restart persistence and host kiosk shell after operator environment correction. No synthetic effective-file evidence was used.

The original checker compared listed/unlisted policy values statically and did not perform a real browser permission-state probe. No material policy, credential, restart, Docker-port or ownership break was found; a bounded CDP browser probe was added and fresh functional/semantic verification is required.

Two fresh reviewers confirmed the real CDP browser probe: listed https://localhost:8443 is granted and unlisted https://localhost:9443 remains prompt for all LNA permission names; kiosk origin is restored and no synthetic policy evidence is used.

Fresh adversarial review passed the real listed/unlisted browser permission probe, exact effective policy, restart persistence, no wildcard/credential leakage, Docker separation and anti-goals with no material finding.
Scheduler closed TASK-063 after Attempt 4 functional PASS and required T3 semantic-pass; the prior semantic concern was corrected with a real CDP listed/unlisted origin probe inside task scope.

evidence_required: FT-003-AC-017 RED: no source-managed Chromium Local Network Access policy exists; GREEN: the effective managed kiosk policy contains LocalNetworkAccessAllowedForUrls with exactly the central Face Moment origin and no wildcard/unrelated origin, survives browser restart and makes that origin eligible for the later ESP32 integration while an unlisted origin receives no pre-authorization; decisive comparison: scripts/check-kiosk-lna.sh compares source and chrome://policy/effective policy plus listed/unlisted-origin probes without reading secrets; artifact: redacted inspection under .tasks/TASK-063-T3-FT-003-W1/.
purpose: Own the deployable/reversible managed Chromium LNA prerequisite independently of sensor application code.
success_outcome: Only the central Face Moment origin is pre-authorized for local-network access in the managed kiosk profile.
anti_goals: Do not implement ESP32 polling/CORS/Bearer behavior.
Do not use wildcard or store any sensor/display secret in policy.
Do not change kiosk sandbox or port topology.

forbidden_scope: Kiosk/port controls owned by TASK-049 and TASK-065
stop_conditions: Effective Chromium policy cannot represent the exact origin.

constraints: Use a source-managed managed-policy artifact and focused read-only check.
Authorize exactly the configured central Face Moment origin.
invariants: No credential is stored in policy.
TASK-046 depends on this task for real-browser sensor integration.
verification_targets: Listed versus unlisted origin eligibility probe.
